integrity: The explicit cubic host and 4096-state necklace-block DP are recomputed by the included standard-library verifier. scientific_limitations: Binary length-five roots and integer power exponent at least three; linear shortest common superstrings only. Finite exact necklace-block DP; no claims about other root lengths, circular superstrings or counts of all optimal hosts.
title: Exact binary length-five power-superstring optimum for every exponent at least three
